backup.production_rule: SPEC-47b ID face box (D-346 unchanged: ID photos are KEPT; no photo is moved or deleted). New nullable column guest_companions.id_face_box (CHECK id_face_box_shape: null or exactly {x,y,w,h,src}, numbers normalised 0-1 in the stored frame, src vision or none; reset to null by a BEFORE UPDATE OF id_photo_path trigger, as id_photo_rotation is). id_face_todo_v1(p_limit) lists up to 20 {companion_id, path} whose photo has no box, oldest first; set_id_face_box_v1(companion, path, box) stores a box only while the path is current and returns false for a replaced photo or an invalid box; both service_role only. The box reaches the app in two places: staff_guest_card_v1 gains ONE key, id_face_box, beside id_photo_path under the same gate (s96 body md5 c0b8c068b8fffb86e0e812b7207d96a6 guarded; staff_home_v1 merges the card with || so current_guest / next_guest carry it, and is unchanged), and staff_photo_rotation_v1 (the one function that carries id_photo_rotation) gains a third returned column id_face_box under the same gate (s91 body md5 ab62dcfe266d9a252eea95b732a2cff2 guarded; dropped and re-created because a result type cannot change in place, grants restated). pg_cron id-face-locate-10m (*/10 * * * *) calls the id-face-locate edge function with the vault cron secret, plus job_heartbeats row id-face-locate (86400 s, no ops risk).
backup.notes: Additive: one nullable column, two new functions, one trigger, two replaced functions (md5 guarded; old clients ignore the extra key and column), one cron job and heartbeat seed. No data is moved or deleted at apply. Deploy order: SQL, then the id-face-locate edge function (--no-verify-jwt; the cron job fails quietly until it exists), then the Staff app. The cron job drains the existing photos at 20 per run.

rollback.safe_until: Always. The rollback script restores staff_guest_card_v1 to the s96 body and staff_photo_rotation_v1 to the s91 body, drops the id-face-locate-10m job and heartbeat, the two functions, the trigger and its function, the CHECK and the column. The stored face boxes are lost by design (the cron job refills them); no photo is touched.
